name: Date the Dude
source: You're blessed with the power to travel through dimensions to look for your perfect boyfriend. He's smelly, he's a ginger, and he's addicted to "health pipes". You only have one chance to win him over (or multiple if you just replay the game) so make it count!
translation: 你有幸拥有穿越维度的能力来寻找你完美的男朋友。他臭，他姜，还沉迷于“健康烟斗”。你只有一次机会赢得他的青睐（如果你只是重玩游戏，则有多次机会），所以要珍惜这次机会！
